$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: the console's own strings (namespace `console::`); Boundary: keys referenced by this app only, every other namespace comes from the consumed services; the derived keys of its own declarations (shortcuts, enums, documents) sit under their kind segment and authored keys never do; every Arabic plural carries zero, one, two, few, many and other; Runtime: browser; Governing contract: ADR 0294 d20 (derived keys), ADR 0234 d9, ADR 0080, ADR 0192 (ICU plurals)

manifest.name: Acme Console
manifest.description: Orders, catalogue and stock for your store, online or offline.

quick_order.name: Quick order
quick_order.description: Place an order for a customer in a few taps.

palette.placeholder: Type a command, a page, or what you want to do…
palette.no_match_hint: Try a page name, an action, or describe what you want to do.

tenant.none_body: Ask an administrator to add you to a tenant.
tenant.switch_blocked_by_queue: Sync your pending changes before switching tenant.

offline.body: {count, plural, =0 {Changes you make will sync when you are back online.} one {# change is waiting to sync.} other {# changes are waiting to sync.}}

queue.empty_body: Changes you make offline appear here until they reach the server.
queue.conflict_hint: The server changed this record while you were offline. Choose how to resolve it.
queue.discard_confirm_body: The change you made offline is deleted and never reaches the server.

welcome.title: Welcome to your console
welcome.body: Everything your services declared is already here: products, orders, stock. Start with a quick order.
welcome.empty_body: A tenant admin can build one in the page builder.

login.title: Signing you in
